{{Quote|Bimmisaari. Fur and moving plants a speciality.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="HTTE" />}}
'''Bimmisaari''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Halla sector/Legends|Halla sector]] and the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Bimm (furred species)/Legends|Bimm]] [[Species/Legends|species]], as well as the adopted homeworld of a [[Bimm/Legends|near-Human race of the same name]] who settled the planet in [[2000 BBY/Legends|2000 BBY]]. The planet was directly represented in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] and allowed a [[Refugee Relief Movement/Legends|RRM]] settlement in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During the Clone Wars the planet was located within [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]]-contested space and [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. It escaped most of the turmoil of the Clone Wars and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] repression thanks to its remote location.

==Description==
[[File:Bimmisaari-TEA.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The city of [[Glastro]].]]
A temperate world of dense jungles and forests of [[asaari tree]]s, Bimmisaari was the homeworld of the [[Bimm (furred species)/Legends|Bimm]] [[Species/Legends|species]], a race of diminutive furred [[Humanoid/Legends|Humanoids]]. Constructing their cities in the middle of vast plains, the planet was colonized by a short [[Near-Human]] race which assimilated into the native population, calling themselves the [[Bimm/Legends|Bimm]] as well. Speaking the [[Bimmini/Legends|same language]] and sharing the same culture, the Bimm were pacifists and attempted to maintain the beauty of their world.<ref name="UAA" />

==History==
Discovered by scouts from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Great Manifest Period/Legends|Great Manifest Period]], Bimmisaari was colonized by a race of [[Bimm/Legends|diminutive Near-Humans]] circa [[2000 BBY/Legends|2000 BBY]]. Forming a unified society with a ban on all weapons, the Bimm were governed by a council of [[Law Elders]] and petitioned the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] for a seat in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. Establishing the [[Tower of Law]] in the capital city of [[Glastro]], to Law Elders would meet within while a bustling marketplace worked outside.<ref name="HTTE" /> Upon gaining representation the Bimm remained loyal to the Republic for centuries, but the decline of the Republic eventually saw Bimmisaari fall within the borders of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. The Bimms welcomed refugees from the Republic that were relocated to their world by the [[Refugee Relief Movement/Legends|Refugee Relief Movement]] and maintained high regard for members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="HNN52" />

[[File:Bimmisaari.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The ''Millennium Falcon'' arrives on Bimmisaari.]]
Following the fall of the Republic, Bimmisaari was incorporated into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="TTS">''[[The Thrawn Trilogy Sourcebook]]''</ref> In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the Imperial [[Grand Moff/Legends|regional governor]] of [[Sector 3 (Oversector)|Sector 3]] was based on Bimmisaari.<ref name="DL:TRoDV">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref>

Bimmisaari began to thrive as a major tradeworld by [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]].<ref name="TTS" /> During the [[Thrawn campaign|reign]] of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]], the Law Elders opened negotiations with the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in an attempt to break ties with the fractured Empire. It was during a diplomatic [[Mission to Bimmisaari|mission]] that Republic representatives [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] had their first encounter with the [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]], who tried to capture Skywalker and Organa Solo.<ref name="HTTE" /> Bimmisaari ultimately did choose to join the New Republic, and other worlds in the Halla sector such as [[Danuta]] followed suit.

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the planet was conquered by the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] invaders, and was [[Battle of Bimmisaari (28 ABY)|raided]] by the New Republic. When the Yuuzhan Vong were defeated, the Bimms aligned with the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] on the basis that their world would be provided aid to help them rebuild. When aid never came, the Bimms grew impatient and when [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Cha Niathal]] removed [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Cal Omas]], the Bimms began to question their allegiance to a fracturing government which failed to provide for them. Upon hearing of the [[Battle of Kashyyyk (Second Galactic Civil War)|burning]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] by the Alliance, the Bimms seceded and joined the [[Confederation]] forming against the Alliance as the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] progressed.

==Behind the scenes==
The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places Bimmisaari in the [[Fakir sector/Legends|Fakir sector]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Galactic Core]]. The Fakir sector is actually located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].
